Clasificar los movimientos del plano fue: Classifying the isometries of the plane was the seed of an enormous idea. In 1872, Felix Klein proposed in his Erlangen Programme defining each geometry by the group of transformations leaving its properties unchanged. Euclidean geometry is that of the isometries; if you also admit enlargements you get affine geometry; and so on up to topology, where any continuous deformation is allowed. The same figure is “the same” or not according to which transformations you consider legal.
